errors.text_span: подредени в низходящ ред по години
errors.evidence: The description states that the time periods on the vertical axis are ordered in descending order by year. In fact, they are ordered chronologically (ascending) from the bottom ('1990-1995') to the top ('2013-2018').
The description uses the word 'Височината' (height) to describe the measure of the horizontal bars. The more precise term for a horizontal bar chart is 'дължината' (length).
